name: search_clinical_trials
description: Search for clinical studies related to a disease or condition. Returns a list of relevant records with summaries. Use this tool to find information about a medical condition.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: The disease or medical condition to search for.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

results.description: List of matching records, each with a title and summary.

return_schema.description: Object containing a list of matching records.
